dedupe_keys.name: design and performance characteristics of extended c band amplifiers

description: Rapp, Lutz and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The analysis compares a conventional two-stage EDFA with increased bandwidth against two parallel split-band amplifiers. Noise figure, gain bandwidth and achievable fibre-link capacity determine where a single device remains advantageous. Coverage is optical transmission-component design; a geographical network and experimental sampling period are not specified. This documented design model supports comparison of physical communication equipment, without asserting a packaged optimiser. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-nc-nd-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
